title: Quick chicken and watercress
summary: Quick chicken and watercress is a british dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and watercress, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Quick chicken and watercress chopped before the pan goes on. Pat skinless chicken breast fillets dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook skinless chicken breast fillets until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook watercress and radishes until hot and lightly browned. Return skinless chicken breast fillets and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Quick chicken and watercress, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Quick chicken and watercress before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
